title: GET /api/decks/:id/check → consistency (D1555, #3802)
description: The `consistency` the deck v2 adapter's `consistency` method passes through from the deck check's reply: the deck's own figures card against card (`services/deckConsistency.ts`). Free, no model. A reader who is not the founder gets null and the adapter answers none. D1511 (#3762).
